_readme: The opener the agent SPEAKS first on an outbound call, per language. ElevenLabs speaks `first_message` verbatim, so it cannot be 'translated on the fly' — it has to already be in the right language, which is what this file is for. Built as: greeting-for-time-of-day + identity confirmation + (optional) language-preference question. `{{customer_name}}` is filled by ElevenLabs; `{langs}` is filled with the native names of the profile's primary + mirror languages. These are plain editable templates: if a native speaker wants to refine the wording for a client, change it here, no code involved. Any language missing from this file falls back to English.
